invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格突破642（基于ATR调整），或融资费率Z-score回落至50%以下（多头风险缓解），或日线趋势转牛（价格突破SMA50 633.82）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks above 642 (adjusted based on ATR), or funding Z-score falls below 50% (long risk eases), or daily trend turns bullish (price > SMA50 633.82).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格突破0.096（基于ATR 0.0009和阻力位），或融资费率Z-score回落至50%以下（多头风险缓解），或日线趋势转牛（价格突破SMA50 0.10）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks above 0.096 (based on ATR 0.0009 and resistance), or funding Z-score falls below 50% (long risk eases), or daily trend turns bullish (price > SMA50 0.10).
